evidence.decision: Separates app inactivity, window focus, window close and audio interruption; retains the visionOS exception rather than pausing every attention shift.
evidence.artifact: Requires lifecycle/event matrix with retained state and timely completion routes, plus actual revised handlers or specification.
evidence.transformation: Spatial lecture continues when looking at notes, preserves annotations on window close and treats Now Playing closure separately.
evidence.verification: Checks app switch, resize, competing audio and close/reopen; lost work, indiscriminate resume and routine notification spam fail.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies iPad configuration privacy, Mac key/main cues, Shared versus Full Space and unsupported Watch multitasking; background execution requires runtime proof.
evidence.handoffs: Windows, Playing audio and Playing video provide detailed lifecycle/media treatment only where the task calls for them.
evidence.distinctiveness: Event-specific focus/closure interpretation and resumable-audio policy are distinct multitasking decisions.
